name: Klöttinger Bauer
beschreibung: The traditional Klöttinger Bauer welcomes guests to the community of Langkampfen in the lower Inn Valley near Kufstein. Nestled between the Brandenberg Alps and the Kaisergebirge, the property embodies authentic Tyrolean rural warmth. Its peaceful country setting provides ideal conditions for leisurely walks, cycling tours along the Inn Cycle Path, and mountain excursions. With convenient connections to Kufstein, historic landmarks such as Kufstein Fortress, local swimming lakes, and ski areas are just a short drive away.
kurzbeschreibung: Traditional farmhouse inn in Langkampfen in Tyrol's lower Inn Valley near Kufstein.
